recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結被大量緊密排列（back-to-back）的濾泡取代，而且濾泡本身（生發中心）呈強陽性 BCL2 染色；反應性生發中心應為 BCL2 陰性，這是濾泡性淋巴瘤（follicular lymphoma）的關鍵線索。
features: Lymph node with effaced architecture by numerous closely packed, variably sized neoplastic follicles
Strong, uniform BCL2 staining throughout the follicles (germinal center compartment)
Follicles lack a distinct negative (BCL2-) germinal center with surrounding positive mantle
Interfollicular areas show weaker, scattered BCL2 positivity (background T cells)
Some follicles show irregular, serpiginous outlines with focal central pallor
describe_en: Low-power view of a lymph node immunostained for BCL2 shows effacement of normal architecture by numerous closely packed follicles of varying size and irregular contour. The follicles show strong, diffuse BCL2 expression, which is more intense than that of the interfollicular T-cell–rich areas, and no BCL2-negative germinal centers are identified. Findings are consistent with nodal follicular lymphoma with aberrant BCL2 expression in follicle center cells.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers are BCL2-negative with only scattered positive T cells, contain tingible-body macrophages, and show zonation and high polarized Ki-67.

ddx.dx: Nodal marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: MZL cells are BCL2+ but CD10/BCL6-negative and colonize residual germinal centers, which retain CD10+/BCL2- remnants.
MCL nodules are BCL2+ but cyclin D1/SOX11-positive and CD10/BCL6-negative.
